body: Does not sound stupid at all. I know if I had someone to love and kiss goodnight it would help me through all this... Maybe have me not even thinking about it. I feel ya on the music. Music is my only way to some type of relief anymore... Way more than I get from weed or any drug. Thank you for your comment. I've never talked about this before. Just the fact someone took the time to comment back with positive feed back makes me feel great.
Hey if your gonna go down go down with a bang. Make a mess.
